question: LAC (Line of Actual Control) is an effective border between India and ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **LAC (Line of Actual Control)** is the demarcation that separates Indian-controlled territory from Chinese-controlled territory. 
 
• LAC is the demarcation that was formed after the **1962 Sino-Indian War** and is part of the Sino-Indian border dispute.
 
• The term is said to have been used by **Zhou Enla**i in a **1959 **letter to Jawaharlal Nehru.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Important borders with India and their names-

 
 

 India and Pakistan
